d:
A massive bipedal reptilian species with thick obsidian black scales and a heavy armored hide. Glowing molten orange eyes with a predatory, fierce expression. A huge muscular body with four sharp claws on each hand. A thick, spiked tail ending in a heavy bony club, colored deep charcoal grey. Large leathery wings with a tattered wing membrane of dark crimson red.
BODY COLOR: obsidian black
